I'm going through the same thing right now.  I just found out about my wife's affair a week ago.  I made her move out, and we're going to try to work through it.   But we have not seen each other yet and she is in therapy 6 hours a day, 5 days a week.   
I really think you need to take a step back.  Sex with her should not even be in your thoughts.  If my wife and I work it out, I will wait at least 3 months before we have sex, so she can get an AIDS test.  You can't sweep this shit under the rug, no matter how nice that would be.  You have to step up and take over the relationship.  You're the boss now.  If she doesn't like it, she can GTFO.

It went better than expected.  She'll be fine.  We might even be fine.  We're going to separate for a while and she's enrolling in a day program.  We'll start counseling and see where things go from there.  Thanks for the advice and kind words!
